status: Initial public-data demonstration. The encoder is MobileNetV3-Large trained with ArcFace on public images of live cattle (experiment E0). It has not been trained or tested on Rwandan cattle or smartphone photos. Post-mortem performance has not been measured.

thresholds.source: E0 dev animals scored by the exported TFLite model, FAR 1% and 0.1%

calibration: Thresholds were set on 52 development animals from a public database of live cattle (experiment E0, live-to-live).
